subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public skills config contract should OpenClaw support for disabling built-in `.agents/skills` sources?
rationale: The report is source-reproducible, but solving it adds a new public `skills.load` option and changes built-in source behavior; repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface and requires maintainer intent for compatibility semantics.

options.title: General source-disable list
options.body: Add a typed `skills.load.disabledSources`-style setting for known skill source ids and apply it before both discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Narrow personal-source toggle
options.body: Add only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle, minimizing config surface but leaving project `.agents/skills` and future source controls separate.

options.title: Keep always-on sources
options.body: Decline a new opt-out and steer affected users to per-skill disables or prompt-limit settings, preserving the current cross-agent convention unchanged.

recommendation.title: General source-disable list
recommendation.body: Add a typed `skills.load.disabledSources`-style setting for known skill source ids and apply it before both discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent release history point to this person for the migrated skills loader, watcher, config, and docs surface where the decision would be implemented.
